info.title: Storyly External API
info.description: The Storyly External API manages apps, instances, story groups, stories, audiences and segments for Storyly, App Samurai's in-app content experience product. Harvested verbatim from the Storyly ReadMe documentation hub (docs.storyly.io/.well-known/api-catalog -> docs.storyly.io/openapi/68f9ff1ab2a841f03a72b06b).

get.description: List all apps for the authenticated account.
Get story groups by instance or specific story group ID.

segments.description: Optional - Story group segments as JSON

settings.description: Optional - Story group settings as JSON

delete.description: Delete a story group by ID.

get.description: Get stories in a story group.
List all audiences for the authenticated account.

activity.description: The user activity on the selected interactive component

app_id.description: The id of the app if interactive audience is selected

audience_identifier.description: The unique identifier of the audience table

component_id.description: The id of the interactive component

file.description: The file to be uploaded if CSV has been selected

interactive_type.description: The type of the interactive to get statistics and create audience within the story

story_group_id.description: The id of the story group  if interactive audience is selected

story_id.description: The id of the story if interactive audience is selected

type.description: The type of the audience, '1' if CSV, '4' if interactive

audience_identifier.description: The unique identifier of the audience table

get.description: List all segments for the authenticated account.
